bossPrompt: Production 2D animation sprite atlas, EXACT SAME boss identity as reference, detailed hand-painted haunted toybox design, same ornaments, palette, anatomy and proportions. EXACT 2x2 equal cells on genuine transparent alpha, 4 complete whole-body poses, generous margins. Row-major: (1) strong attack anticipation/compression; (2) attack release, distinct extended anatomy and opening mouth/core; (3) recoil / hurt; (4) final collapsed defeat with extinguished core, broken/folded anatomy still recognizable. Pose changes substantial, not scaled/rotated copies. Consistent scale, perspective, ground baseline. No text, floor, shadows, target circles. Full appendages inside cells. Do not add weapons or unrelated characters.

weapons.prompt: Original production 2D game sprite animation atlas. Whole subject inside each cell. No added arms on friendly characters; hands/weapons are separate in game. Do not draw any weapons on characters. Missing rows stay empty alpha. Weapons keep exact original orientation and grip position across poses, no hands/bodies/projectiles. Flex blade, open jaws/fan, compress pump, release bellows or charge core according to the weapon. No detached fragments or muzzle flashes.
